a.lede: Lego fans demand answers as outage approaches a week with no confirmed cause
a.title: Lego marketplace BrickLink in pieces after 'unusual activity' takes it offline for almost a week

b.title: Lego marketplace BrickLink offline after 'unusual activity' detected
